original_point_reconciliation.rule: Exact scalar/None equality to canonical JSON using exact hash-pinned frozen baselines.score, _average_precision, _auc and calibration_table AST definitions plus exact dependent definitions/constants/imports on identical canonical float64 entries/order. No selectable tolerance for original points. Bind all copied AST/source hashes and dependency versions. Do not compare raw Brier to c651 brier_mc_variance_corrected.
original_point_reconciliation.resample_verification: For separate grouped sufficient-statistic versus independent literal-concatenation comparisons only, pre-fix rtol=1e-12 and atol=1e-14; original-point reconciliation remains exact. Null/status/count/frequency/source/artifact identities require exact equality. Never choose tolerances from actual results.

census_receipt.cross_bindings: assessment_sha256.us2024/korea2025 must match authorization and current assessment bytes. cohorts.us2024/korea2025 structures must match the frozen checker output and273/33 expected/represented cases; independently read exact cohort_census source for all child keys. Honest unavailable/failed census outcomes are retained, but complete-scoring per-cohort admission below still applies.

canonical_result_review.cross_bindings: authorized_source_head must equal root authorization canonical_review_source_head; selection_sha256/registry_sha256/results_sha256 match authorization and current files. cohorts.heldout/korean2025 carry assessment_status,events,cases,statuses,scored_fires,entries. Full-cohort supplement requires COMPLETE,6/4 events,273/33 cases, exactly SCORED counts273/33,6/4 scored_fires and positive entries, verified per cohort; otherwise that cohort supplement remains null/unavailable. Primary scientific HOLD does not block a complete supported cohort. Do not require a primary-superiority true value.

root_actual_authorization.identity_object: Every identity is an object with exactly path and sha256; sha256 lowercase64hex. Paths for canonical/artifact/production source identities are repository-relative, normalized and contained in model_root. Trusted review/checker/protocol copies may be bundled byte-for-byte under separate supplement evidence. Reject traversal/duplicate JSON keys/nonfinite JSON values and wrong scalar types.
root_actual_authorization.canonical_bindings: Mapping with keys results,selection,registry,assessments,frozen_assessments,figures. First3 are identities. assessments/frozen_assessments have us2024 and korea2025 identities. figures maps exact canonical5 names to png/svg identities. All current bytes must match; no overwrite.
root_actual_authorization.prerequisite_receipts: Object with exactly census and canonical_result identities. Their exact bytes/hashes and required/cross-bound fields above must validate. Separate checker source copies also have to match the fixed source hashes.
root_actual_authorization.source_bindings: supplement_source and independent_source_review are identities. Current executing candidate source bytes must match supplement_source. Root pins the completed independent source-review artifact; do not replace it with a caller boolean.
root_actual_authorization.frozen_files_sha256: Exactly the223 path:sha256 pairs from authenticated root FREEZE_PARENT_VERIFICATION.json verified_file_sha256; preserve all current bytes and compare before/after. Expected root proof file SHA1e9def628deb2e7f1035aea691c39f8acf27f606bcdccffd0e6d3dff4f344db6.
root_actual_authorization.input_artifacts_sha256: Exact path:sha256 mapping for every consumed saved canonical artifact, including all consumed per-fire files, assessment/frozen JSON, canonical result, prerequisite/source-review receipts and protocol/spec. Verify all before numerical loads and after; existing independent canonical result receipt already authenticates case-to-fire alignment. Do not consume any unlisted scientific artifact.
root_actual_authorization.trust_boundary: The outer authorization file digest must equal an independently supplied expected SHA from root trusted task message/command or immutable published root record. The authorization body cannot supply its own expected hash. A caller boolean is never sufficient. A hash is custody of bytes, not cryptographic proof of author identity or reviewer independence. This is the explicit orchestration trust boundary.
root_actual_authorization.unavailable_rule: A full306 membership receipt can include honest failures. After authenticating both receipts, reject complete-supplement computation only for the affected incomplete-scoring cohort and write its explicit unavailable/null result; never silently compute its available subset, never cancel the other complete cohort.
root_actual_authorization.checker_sources: Exactly census and canonical_result identities; verify current copied checker bytes against both their declared SHA and the two hardcoded original source hashes above.
root_actual_authorization.output_relative_directory: A normalized repository-relative directory under research/forecast-v2/supplements/. It must not exist before the actual run; create exclusively and refuse symlink/path escape or overlap with any source/input/canonical/frozen protected path. Write only new separate supplement artifacts there. Set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for the actual command.

graph_evidence.coverage_census: check_census.py metadata_match/no recorded issue; cohort_census child output keys delegated for exact source read
graph_evidence.scope: Receipt fields/source only; no current study result, NPZ, metric or model loaded.
